headline_marked: Man [[dies after snakebite]] in Faridpur following traditional healing
headline: Man dies after snakebite in Faridpur following traditional healing
summary: Alamgir Sheikh, an e-bike driver and snake catcher, died at Faridpur Medical College Hospital after seeking traditional healing from his father first.
details: Alamgir Sheikh, 45, died on Friday at Faridpur Medical College Hospital after being bitten by a snake. He was a resident of Chhlenama village in the Akot-er Char union of Sadarpur upazila.
The incident occurred around 9:00 AM on Friday when Alamgir went to the Shaitan-khali Ghat char to catch a snake. During the attempt, he was bitten by the snake.

Instead of going to a hospital immediately, Alamgir first sought help from his father, Chattar Sheikh, who is known locally as an 'ojha' (traditional healer). His father attempted to remove the venom using traditional rituals and incantations.
As his condition deteriorated, he was first taken to the Charbhadrasan Upazila Health Complex and then referred to Faridpur Medical College Hospital, where he passed away at 1:30 PM.

Medical Officer Mizanur Rahman of Charbhadrasan Upazila Health Complex warned that snakebite victims should be taken to the nearest hospital immediately without wasting time with traditional healers, as delays often make medical intervention impossible.

topic: mob destroys house of accused in rape and murder of student
headline_marked: Mob [[demolishes house of prime suspect]] in child rape and murder case
headline: Mob demolishes house of prime suspect in child rape and murder case
summary: An angry crowd in Pabna destroyed the home of Mostafa Pramanik after a 10-year-old girl was raped and killed.
details: A mob demolished the house of the prime suspect in the rape and murder of a 10-year-old schoolgirl in Pabna Sadar. The attack occurred on Friday, with the crowd destroying the two-story building from afternoon until 6 PM.
The victim, a fourth-grade student, went missing on September 9. Her fragmented body was recovered from a pond near her home on September 16.
Police arrested Mostafa Pramanik, a grocer, and his tenant Yasin Ali. According to Pabna Police Superintendent Abu Ashraf, the suspects confessed to raping the child before strangling her to death.
Investigation revealed the suspects hid the body under a bed and later dumped it in a pond in a sack tied with bricks to hide the crime.
The mob attack was triggered by public outrage over the brutality of the crime. Locals stated they wanted to ensure no trace of the suspect's presence remained in the community.

Pabna Sadar Police Station OC Tariqul Islam confirmed that while police were present, they were outnumbered by the crowd and could not stop the demolition. The situation has since been brought under control.
